material_type: Cells were harvested via centrifugation at 21,000xg 4°C 1h (Thermo scientific, Sorvall Lynx 4000 centrifuge), the supernatant discarded and the resulting pellet resuspended in 1ml of spent medium, followed by another round of centrifugation at 21,000xg 4°C for 1h (Eppendorf, Centrifuge 5424R).
sample_source: Cells were harvested via centrifugation at 21,000xg 4°C 1h (Thermo scientific, Sorvall Lynx 4000 centrifuge), the supernatant discarded and the resulting pellet resuspended in 1ml of spent medium, followed by another round of centrifugation at 21,000xg 4°C for 1h (Eppendorf, Centrifuge 5424R).
strain: Capsaspora owczarzaki strain ATCC30864 filopodial cells were grown axenically in 5 ml flasks with ATCC medium 1034 (modified PYNFH medium) in an incubator at 23ºC (Sebé-Pedrós et al., 2013a).
